deployment_context.provenance: Revision and commit supplied by parent; this check inspected the live rendered site, not repository state.

method: Own OpenAI cloud desktop Chromium, supported CUA CDP lane. Fresh QA tab with cache-busting page query in existing browser profile. Read-only DOM measurements, actual screenshots, normal anchor navigation and keyboard Details toggles. Not a controlled cold-cache or delayed-network test.
outcome: Dimension reservation and bounded middle/last anchor regression passed under observed desktop conditions.

dimensions.caveat: Only naturally loaded images were compared to browser naturalWidth/naturalHeight. All 193 attributes were inspected, not all 193 rendered images revisited.
dimensions.lazy_reservation: Initially incomplete main images had reserved nonzero layout boxes before download completion. Main hero boxes included 648x580 and landscape 648x432.90625; sheet boxes included 980.9375x850 and landscape 980.9375x654.625. Collapsed Details were not claimed to have visible boxes.

navigation.interpretation: Both anchors settled on the intended identity heading before and after relevant lazy-image completion. Immediate post-click readings occurred during smooth scrolling and were not treated as failed landings.
navigation.measurement_limit: First lazy-load comparisons retained identical document coordinates and heights. Later full-page captures coincided with reported viewport/card-width changes: card width 980.9375 to 997.9375; final viewport 1188x761 at DPR1. Final middle document Y was 13054.796875; last document Y 25144.828125 and height2615.828125. Therefore this report does not claim globally invariant document coordinates or a controlled CLS measurement across the entire session.
